plugins.name: paper-summary
plugins.description: Turn an arXiv id, local PDF, or URL into a structured, grounded summary and a typeset PDF. Prefers the arXiv LaTeX e-print source so equations, original figures (including EPS), and the .bbl survive intact. Ships an ingestion engine, per-field domain checklists (hep-ex/ph/th/lat, ai, physics), a grounding checker that traces every number back to the source, and a pandoc-to-typst renderer with Korean support.
